answer: In this PoA design, an agent identity is issued only after remote attestation proves that a TEE runs approved code, binding its public key to the enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE). A copied virtual machine cannot reproduce the hardware-rooted attestation quote or enclave-held private key; creating another identity therefore requires another attested processor, making Sybil expansion costly through physical silicon purchase. “harbor,” “quartz,” and “echo” are merely metadata, not trust anchors.
